description: Pause (PAUSED) or enable (ACTIVE) a campaign, ad squad or ad. Enabling shows the daily budget that would really start delivering (including the ACTIVE ad squads under a campaign) and is refused above the configured limits. Previews unless confirm=true. Never deletes. For several items at once pass ids instead of the single id: Enable (ACTIVE) or pause (PAUSED) up to 20 campaigns, ad squads or ads in one go. Previews unless confirm=true: shows each change, skips ones already in that state, warns when a parent is paused, and for ACTIVE shows the daily budget that would really start delivering (refused above the configured limits). Stops at the first failure and reports exactly what changed. Never deletes.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

entity.description: What to act on: campaign, adsquad or ad (ad squads are Snapchat's ad sets).

id.description: Id of the item named by entity. Get it from snap_list_campaigns, snap_list_adsquads or snap_list_ads.

ids.description: Ids of the items to change, at most 20. Get them from the matching matching list tool.

status.description: ACTIVE or PAUSED. Items you create always start PAUSED.

name: snap_set_status
